vibe: Professional, authoritative, clean, and dynamic (sports-driven without being overly 'gym-bro' or childish). Parent-friendly but admin-powerful.

headings.usage: Use Outfit for all Dashboard Page Titles, Section Headers, and KPI numeric values to give a modern, sporty geometric feel.

body.usage: Use Manrope for all table data, forms, and general UI text for crystal clear legibility for parents and admins.

hierarchy.h1: text-3xl md:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-bold tracking-tighter text-slate-900

accent.name: Volt Yellow
accent.usage: Use strictly for highlights: active menu items, warnings, or secondary CTAs. Do NOT overuse.

spacing_and_layout.general: Mobile-first approach. Generous padding in cards (p-6 or p-8) to avoid data clutter.

grids.admin_dashboard: Control Room Grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6. KPI summaries in col-span-1. Main charts in col-span-2 or col-span-full.
grids.parent_portal: Bento Grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8. Make student profiles the dominant visual (col-span-full md:col-span-8).

spacing_and_layout.alignment: Left-align all tables, inputs, and standard content. Center-align only major empty states or specific modal CTAs.

surface_strategies.cards: Neumorphism Tactile variant. bg-white border border-slate-200 shadow-sm rounded-xl. Avoid heavy drop shadows.
surface_strategies.sidebar: Dark theme sidebar (bg-slate-900 text-slate-300) to create 'Command Center' contrast against the light content area.
surface_strategies.headers: Sticky headers with crystal glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-b border-slate-200.

components.tables: Use clear 1px borders for rows (border-b border-slate-100). No vertical borders. Striped backgrounds on hover only (hover:bg-slate-50). Status badges must be rounded-full with light bg and dark text.
components.forms: Use Shadcn UI Inputs. rounded-lg, focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-600/20 focus:border-blue-600.
components.buttons: rounded-lg font-medium. Primary: bg-blue-600 text-white shadow-sm. Secondary: bg-white text-slate-700 border border-slate-200.
components.charts: Use Recharts. Minimal grid lines (strokeDasharray='3 3' stroke='#E2E8F0'). Tooltips must have rounded-lg bg-white shadow-md border border-slate-200.
components.icons: Phosphor Icons (Duotone weight for marketing/parent views, Regular/Bold for dense admin dashboards).

animations.interactive: hover:-translate-y-[2px] hover:shadow-md transition-all duration-200 for actionable cards.
animations.loading: Use skeleton loaders with pulse animation (bg-slate-200 rounded-lg) rather than spinners for dashboard content.

hero_login_bg.description: Wide-angle premium indoor badminton court for login or marketing hero background.
hero_login_bg.usage: Use with bg-black/40 overlay to ensure login form text contrast.

dashboard_header_texture.description: Abstract sleek geometric slate and blue texture.
dashboard_header_texture.usage: Can be used as a subtle banner background in the parent portal or coach dashboard header.

equipment_showcase.description: Premium badminton racket on white towel.
equipment_showcase.usage: Use for empty states, 'No upcoming classes', or registration success screens.

stock_court_match.description: Indoor badminton court with blue walls and floor.

stock_coach.usage: Use as a default avatar for coaches if none exists.

instructions_to_main_agent: INSTALLATION: Add Google Fonts 'Outfit' and 'Manrope' to your index.html or tailwind layout.
LAYOUT STRUCTURE: Use a persistent dark sidebar (bg-slate-900 text-white) for Admin/Coach roles, and a top navigation (glassmorphism) for Parent portal.
DASHBOARDS: Build the Admin Dashboard using grid-cols-4 for top KPIs (Income, Expenses, Net Profit, Students). Use Recharts for the Profit line chart.
TABLES: Build a unified Reusable Table component using Shadcn for Sessions, Payments, and Expenses. Ensure status badges follow the color_palette.status rules.
Avoid full-screen generic gradients. Use the provided texture image or clean white backgrounds (bg-slate-50 for app background, bg-white for cards).
DO NOT use generic grey text for headers; use text-slate-900 or text-slate-800 for strong contrast.
For all interactive elements, apply hover/focus states properly.

data_testid_conventions.rule: All interactive elements must include a kebab-case data-testid attribute describing its role.
